mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) reflects expanding manufacturing output and economic activity, which typically leads to higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in 60% or more of periods when INDPRO is rising.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% indicates a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in 60% or more of instances where UNRATE < 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and increase in residential sales (RSAFS) signals accommodative monetary policy and strong housing demand, which together produce positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
regime_hint: monetary easing and strong housing demand
failure_condition: The joint signal (FEDFUNDS down and RSAFS up) fails to generate positive 20-day returns in 60% or more of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation periods (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), the Federal Reserve typically tightens monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as higher rates pressure equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in 60% or more of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, which consistently drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of the broader economic context.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in 60% or more of instances when HOUST is rising.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals economic weakness and reduced consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days as market participants anticipate lower corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in 60% or more of instances where UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in industrial production (INDPRO) and fall in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates robust economic expansion across manufacturing and labor markets, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (INDPRO up and UNRATE down) fails to produce positive 20-day returns in 60% or more of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of strong consumer demand (RSAFS > 350,000 million dollars), businesses experience higher sales and profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in sustained economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in 60% or more of periods when RSAFS > 350000.
